source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The send tests arm popupshown before opening menus and popuphidden before activation. Newer password-send code also creates the compose-window-close promise before the final send action. Proposed scoped manual async-test rule: create the event promise before the stimulus, then await both event and asserted result. A timeout or arbitrary delay does not provide the same event ordering guarantee. The tests still skip the native macOS menu bar because the helper cannot operate it.
title: Arm browser event waits before invoking the action that can finish quickly
